answer: Bonded-identity staking at the shale: each agent locks collateral C, and slashing forfeits C on any proven duplicate. An echo test broadcasts one challenge; correlated sybils answer on the same block, revealing clustering. The opal ledger records slashes publicly, so cost per fake identity is C, not zero. At C=500 tokens, a 100-sybil farm burns 50,000 tokens before one valid attestation. Works because linear identity gains meet linear capital losses, so farming never scales profitably.
